title: Surreal Dreamscape Lighthouse
description: A vibrant surreal scene depicts a giant orange dragon forming an infinity loop around a steampunk lighthouse on a rocky island. In the foreground, a soldier in camouflage kneels in reflective water gazing at a circular vision of a European town square, while a wizard on a broom and a red-cloaked woman ride the dragon under a smiling crescent moon.
prompt: Highly detailed surreal fantasy painting featuring a massive orange dragon twisted into an infinity symbol encircling a green and white steampunk lighthouse with clock faces. A wizard in blue robes flies on a broom near a smiling crescent moon with faces in the clouds. A woman in red rides the dragon holding a glowing orb while another in yellow holds a small building model. In the foreground a soldier in modern camouflage kneels in reflective water staring into a circular portal showing a town square with fountain. Hot air balloons, brain and face motifs in the purple twilight sky, vibrant flowers and perfect water reflections.
